Without getting into spoilers...

**Pros:** The quiet, downbeat parts were some of my favourites. A lot more of the humour landed for me than it did for Infinity War. I didn't really feel the runtime at all. Dug the... *shenanigans*... of the middle third. It made me a Cap fan, which fell off completely with The Winter Soldier.

**Cons:** Didn't feel the stakes at all. Some of the main *big* ideas could have actually used *more* time to breathe. Didn't like the... final... *play?* Boy, this part is a lot harder to do without spoilers. Basically I didn't fuck with the last third of the movie. Also, the Thanos and Hulk CGI seemed noticeably worse than Infinity War overall. Not "Banner's head photoshopped into the Hulk Buster" bad. But still.
